scripts.test: bun test tests && bun scripts/cargo.ts test -j 2
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:electron && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome check src scripts tests verification *.ts *.json *.cjs src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/capabilities && bun scripts/cargo.ts fmt --check && bun scripts/cargo.ts clippy -j 2 --all-targets -- -D warnings
